# Citizen Forge

A Muse agent skill that helps non-developers create governed internal apps: classify the app's risk tier, apply 35 controls across lifecycle stages, and gate launch behind pre-launch readiness. It handles the full lifecycle — definition, design, build, launch, and retirement — and tells you exactly which artifacts exist for each stage. No account, no API key, no network needed.
